svg.title: One sync run over several legs - selection, independent failure, summary

g.text: One sync run over several legs - selection, independent failure, summary
sync(universe, store, asset_filters, provider_filters, tail, dry_run, force_actions, summary_json)
run_sync(universe, store_path, assets, providers, dry_run, tail, force_actions)
tail >= 1 checked first (JDL-087); today = UTC date of the run clock (JDL-088);
store = --store or defaults.store (JDL-089); legs = enabled asset x enabled source,
filtered, in universe order (JDL-084); bad filter or empty selection is a SyncError (JDL-085)
every leg ok with detail planned, plan lines logged (JDL-104, JDL-105)
collectors built lazily once per provider and closed at the end (JDL-102);
a missing EODHD key fails each eodhd leg (JDL-030); yahoo-csv legs import
their whole file without a collector (JDL-099); log lines per JDL-103
leg results and ok when no leg failed
